integrity: Complete mathematical argument and directly replayable finite adjacency checks are provided; finite checks are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three disjoint clique components, each of order at least three; no theorem for smaller cliques, other numbers of components or other fair-domination multiplicities.
Counts unordered set partitions of labelled vertices, not possible choices of coalition witnesses.
Publication priority is contingent on further bibliography; independently checked mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Fair-coalition extremizers and their census in three-clique cluster graphs
